intactness_rule: Mirrors the lab's V2R curation pipeline: intact = best-scoring miniprot alignment at a locus covers >=80% of its reference V2R protein (coverage_class analogue of repaired_coverage_class=='intact', COV_INTACT=0.80) AND has zero in-frame stop codons (StopCodon/st:i tag) AND zero frameshifts (Frameshift/fs:i tag) on that alignment, with no 7TM domain requirement. Loci = overlapping/near-overlapping (gap<=1000bp) miniprot mRNA alignments on the same chrom+strand, collapsed to one candidate gene; the locus's best-scoring alignment (highest miniprot GFF score) represents it.
verdict: YES: the marine V2R expansion survives a uniform homology re-count (marine mean intact = 924.6 vs terrestrial-elapid mean = 202.5, vs other-outgroup mean = 308.4); marine:terrestrial ratio is 4.57x under the uniform miniprot recount vs 2.32x under the original OrthoFinder annotation-based counts --> similar magnitude, so the expansion looks real rather than an annotation artefact.
